observation.command: cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml ps --format '{{.Name}} | {{.Status}} | {{.Ports}}' 2>&1; echo "=== endpoints ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "web  :8090 -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8090/; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "admin:8091 -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8091/; echo "=== images ==="; docker images | grep -E "audiominer|redis" ; echo "=== web UI content sample ==="; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8090/ | sed -n '1,8p'
